tagline: General Contracting, Landscaping & Hardscaping Across Northeast PA

why_choose_us.title: You get the estimate you were promised
why_choose_us.description: Every project starts with a free, no-obligation walkthrough and an itemized written estimate. No pressure, no surprises, and no waiting three weeks for a number that never arrives.

why_choose_us.title: 30+ years, 500+ projects in this valley
why_choose_us.description: We have been building across Luzerne and Lackawanna Counties for over three decades. We know the housing stock, the inspectors, and what a NEPA winter does to work that was rushed.

why_choose_us.title: One contractor for the whole job
why_choose_us.description: Interior, exterior, hardscaping and landscaping run through the same office. You are not coordinating five trades and hoping they talk to each other — that is our job.

why_choose_us.title: Licensed and insured in Pennsylvania
why_choose_us.description: We are a fully licensed and insured Pennsylvania contractor, and we handle permitting with the local Luzerne and Lackawanna County offices ourselves.
